nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum for Dark Spots and Firming

avis.texte: I absolutely love the viscosity, scent and way this product makes my skin feel. It is incredibly refreshing and does not leave your face feeling oily. This light weight product makes my skin feel refreshed.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Ole Henriksen Banana Bright Vitamin C Serum for a few weeks, and I ended up enjoying it more than I expected. The texture is lightweight, sinks into the skin quickly, and layers well under makeup without any sticky residue. Over this period, my skin has started to look a bit brighter and fresher overall. One of my favorite aspects of this serum is the scent. It has a gentle citrus fragrance that feels calming and elevates my daily skincare routine. The packaging is also thoughtfully designed — clean, simple, and functional. The pump dispenser makes it easy to get the right amount of product without any mess. A few notes of caution: those with sensitive skin might experience slight stinging or redness initially due to the vitamin C. It's also possible to see small breakouts or dry patches while your skin adjusts. This isn't a miracle product that delivers results overnight, but as an everyday brightening serum, I find it to be a lovely addition to a routine. Pros: Lightweight, fast-absorbing formula Pleasant citrus scent Easy-to-use pump packaging Gradual brightening Cons: Possible initial stinging or redness for sensitive skin Adjusting period may cause minor breakouts or dryness Results are subtle and require consistent use ￼

avis.titre: Brightening Results With a Potent Formula — But Sensitive Sk
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is definitely on the stronger side of vitamin C products, and you can feel that in both the results and the first‑week adjustment period. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and has that signature citrus‑leaning scent that fades fast. Once it settles, it layers cleanly under moisturizer without pilling or feeling sticky. In terms of performance, it delivers what it promises: brighter skin, smoother texture, and a more even look overall. After a couple of weeks, I noticed a clearer tone and a bit more firmness, especially in the areas where I tend to look dull. It hydrates well for a vitamin C serum and doesn't leave any greasy residue. That said, the formula is strong. I have somewhat sensitive skin, and during the first week I experienced some noticeable redness — no burning, itching, or dryness, just a flushed look that faded as my skin adjusted. Once that initial period passed, it stopped happening, but it's worth noting for anyone who reacts easily to potent actives. Starting every other day might be the safer route. The only real downside is that this serum can be a bit much for skin that isn't used to higher‑strength vitamin C or PHAs. It's effective, but it's not the gentlest option out there. If your skin barrier is already compromised or you're prone to irritation, patch‑testing is a must.
